# Furlpay

> The on-chain financial operating system — stablecoin payments, global local
> accounts, fractional stock investing, and agentic (AI) payments in one client.
> Phishing-resistant (WebAuthn passkeys), 2-of-2 MPC custody, compliance-aware.

Furlpay is both a consumer app and developer infrastructure. For AI agents, the
most relevant surfaces are the x402 facilitator and the MCP server.

## Capabilities

- Stablecoin payments (USDC, EURC) on Solana and Base
- Global local bank accounts (USD, EUR, GBP, INR)
- Fractional stock investing via Alpaca
- AI agentic payments via x402 protocol
- Solana Actions & Blinks
- Bill splitting & group payments
- Crypto-backed credit lines
- Rewards & cashback program
- MPC + WebAuthn passkey custody (no seed phrases)

## Agentic payments (x402)

- x402 facilitator API: https://furlpay.com/api/x402/facilitator
  - GET  /supported  — scheme/network kinds (solana, base)
  - POST /verify     — validate a payment payload against requirements
  - POST /settle     — verify + settle on-chain (single-use nonce, replay-safe)
- Pay-per-call demo endpoint: https://furlpay.com/api/x402/fx (402 → quote)
- Open-source middleware: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-x402 (@furlpay/x402)
- Docs: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agentic-x402

## Solana Actions & Blinks

- Discovery: https://furlpay.com/actions.json
- Action API: https://furlpay.com/api/actions/pay/{orderId}
- Docs: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/solana-actions
- Template: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-solana-actions-template

## Developer platform (open source: https://github.com/FurlPay)

- Node SDK: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-node (@furlpay/furlpay-node)
- CLI: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-cli (@furlpay/cli)
- MCP server: https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-mcp-server (@furlpay/mcp-server)
- Elements (React): https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-elements
- Account Kit (Safe/ERC-4337): https://github.com/FurlPay/furlpay-account-kit
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://furlpay.com/openapi.json

## Supported networks

| Network  | Token | Settlement |
|----------|-------|------------|
| Solana   | USDC  | ~400ms     |
| Solana   | EURC  | ~400ms     |
| Base     | USDC  | ~2s        |
| Base     | EURC  | ~2s        |

- Docs hub: https://furlpay.com/docs
  Overview of all Furlpay developer documentation and guides.
- Quickstart: https://furlpay.com/docs/quickstart
  Step-by-step guide to integrate Furlpay payments in your app.
- Architecture — Monorepo: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/monorepo
  How the Furlpay codebase is structured as a Turborepo monorepo.
- Architecture — API routes: https://furlpay.com/docs/architecture/api-routes
  Overview of all API route handlers and their responsibilities.
- Integrations — Stripe Crypto Onramp: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/stripe-crypto
  Guide to the Stripe crypto onramp integration for fiat-to-crypto.
- Integrations — Persona KYC: https://furlpay.com/docs/integrations/persona-kyc
  Identity verification flow using Persona for KYC/AML compliance.
- Payments — Agentic x402: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/agentic-x402
  How AI agents can make HTTP 402-based payments using x402 protocol.
- Payments — Solana Actions: https://furlpay.com/docs/payments/solana-actions
  Solana Actions & Blinks integration for shareable payment links.
- Security — MPC + WebAuthn: https://furlpay.com/docs/security/mpc-webauthn
  Passkey-based authentication and 2-of-2 MPC key custody model.
- Compliance — MiCA: https://furlpay.com/docs/compliance/mica
  EU Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation compliance details.
